definitions.gloss: (the listener's or a third party's) parents (polite)
definitions.explanation: Polite form of {両親|りょうしん} used for the parents of the person you are talking to or of a third party. Your own parents, when you speak to outsiders, are {両親|りょうしん} or {親|おや}, without ご.

examples.japanese: ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Before the wedding, he went to pay his respects to her parents.

notes:
The honorific prefix ご turns ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ (parents) into the polite form for other people's parents. It follows the inside/outside rule of family terms: honorific forms for others' families, plain forms for one's own.

USAGE:
- For someone else's parents: ご{両親|りょうしん}
- For your own parents, to outsiders: ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧, ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧
- To address your own parents: ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧, ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: How are your parents?
- ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧: Say hello to your parents
- ご{両親|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}する→挨拶する：01797_aisatsusuru⟧: to pay one's respects to someone's parents

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧: one's own parents
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧: father (polite); ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: mother (polite)
- ⟦お{子|こ}さん→お子さん：01564_okosan⟧: someone else's child (parallel form)
